Name: (CP) Youthful Samantha - Portrait only
Author: AlcoveWorks
Description:
[size=4]This mod adds CP portrait of female Sam (Samantha) that looks more mature / young adult, for anyone who prefer less-Kawaii Portrait.[/size]
[size=4]Has Normal, Winter, Joja, and Beach outfit[/size]
[size=4]Doesn't include sprite or changing her name in-game.[/size]
[size=4]If you wants to change the dialogue and name, I prefer you to use. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].[/size]

[size=4]HOW TO INSTALL : [/size]
[size=4]- Download and install all requirements[/size]
[size=4]- Download and unzip the mod files[/size]
[size=4]- Move the files to your SMAPI mod folder[/size]

[size=4]CAUTION :[/size]
[size=4]Make sure other Portrait mods that affect Sam are turned off in the config, to avoid a clash.[/size]

[size=4]NOTES :[/size]
[size=4]Mod still in progress, might change the artwork to be smoother and more Vanilla friendly. might even add seasonal version.[/size]
[size=4]Might add another Bachelor later on separate mod. or singular mod for every genderbend Bachelor using my style.[/size]

[size=4]This is my first time modding, if there is any error pls let me know.[/size]
